stem: The line of best fit for a set of data predicts \(y = 34\) when \(x = 6\) and \(y = 50\) when \(x = 10\). What value of \(y\) does the line of best fit predict when \(x = 0\)?
solution: From \(x = 6\) back to \(x = 0\), the prediction decreases by \(6(4) = 24\): \(34 - 24 = 10\).
verify:
m, c = symbols('m c')
sol = solve([Eq(6*m + c, 34), Eq(10*m + c, 50)], [m, c])
assert sol[m] == 4 and sol[c] == 10
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [sol[c]]
